description: Secret Santa for a group: draws who gives a gift to whom (one circle; nobody draws themselves; pairs in exclude never draw each other, either way). Free. Returns one private link per person (members[].url: shows only that person whom they give to) and organizerUrl (the list of everyone's links and who has opened theirs, never the pairs). The user sends each person only their own link. Fails with santa_too_few, santa_too_many, santa_duplicate (two people with the same name: add an initial) or santa_impossible (the exclusions leave no draw).

budget.description: Optional, as the user says it, e.g. "€20"

exclude.description: Pairs of names who must not draw each other (couples, people who exchange gifts anyway)

names.description: Everyone taking part, first names, all different

name: create_santa_draw
title: Draw names for Secret Santa
